ios.desc:
The Quadratis puzzles are based on ideas stemming from the math of combinations, shapes and space. 
Designed by mathematicians, they will entertain as well as develop mental agility and encourage strategic thinking.

Slide rows and columns to reproduce the home pattern. To score full points you’ll need to think about which strategy will be fast and use as few moves as possible. Each new puzzle reveals a new twist. The smooth operation and minimalist design accentuate the puzzles’ universal nature which will appeal to players of all ages and backgrounds.
